_comment: Top-exchange official blog RSS sources for the dashboard's Exchanges tab. Each URL is individually verified working before being added. Most major CEXs (Binance, KuCoin, OKX, Bybit) run custom React/Next.js sites with no discoverable RSS feed - only Kraken (WordPress-based) confirmed working so far. Keep searching and add real ones as found, don't guess URL patterns blind.
_notYetConfirmed: Binance - Newsroom/blog is a JS app, no RSS found. Binance Academy has a feed (api.binance.vision/api/feed) but that's educational content, not official announcements/predictions - lower priority.
KuCoin - blog.kucoin.com and the announcement/feed pages are JS apps, no RSS found
OKX - learn/blog section is a JS app, no RSS found
Bybit - press room is a JS app, no RSS found
Bitget - mentioned as RSS-supporting in a support article, direct feed URL not yet confirmed
